form.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Browse
form.description: Every tenant x index x sourcetype we know about, what tier it is, who owns it, and whether it is actually flowing. A dataset is cataloged automatically once it is ingested and its sourcetype has a SIEM contract - for this tenant, or shared from another AE or Core. Per-tenant flowing vs cataloged coverage is on the Auditor page.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | `dc_contract_state` | `dc_effective_gates` | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen events_24h | lookup dc_baselines_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT median_events mad_events | `dc_default_silence` | eval silence_min=if(isnull(last_seen),null(),round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)) | eval health=case(isnull(last_seen),"NEVER_SEEN", silence_min>max_silence_minutes,"DATA_DOWN", isnotnull(median_events) AND events_24h<(median_events-4*mad_events),"VOLUME_LOW", 1=1,"OK") | fields dataset_id uhgid ae_name domain index sourcetype declared_tier proposed_tier status technical_owner contract_status contract_scope contract_held_by siem_status contract_ticket contract_date schema_version gate1_normalization gate1_source gate2_detection gate2_source gate3_soc enterprise_ready last_seen events_24h health notes
| `dc_contracts_enriched` | fields uhgid index sourcetype ae_name contract_issue siem_status siem_completed_epoch
| inputlookup dc_shadow_classification_lookup | fields dataset_id uhgid sourcetype index classification cde_approved exact_ticket any_ticket events_24h
| stats first(ae_name) as ae_name by uhgid | eval ae_name=ae_name." (".uhgid.")" | sort ae_name
| stats count by domain | where domain!="" | sort domain
| where status="active" | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ domain=$domain|s$ declared_tier=$tier|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | stats count

| where status="active" | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ domain=$domain|s$ declared_tier=$tier|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | eval o=if(isnotnull(technical_owner) AND technical_owner!="",1,0) | stats sum(o) as owned, count as total | eval pct=if(total=0,0,round(owned/total*100,1)) | fields pct
| search uhgid=$tenant|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | where siem_status="SIEM complete" | stats count
| search uhgid=$tenant|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | where siem_status="SIEM complete" AND siem_completed_epoch>=relative_time(now(),"-30d@d") | stats count

single.title: Datasets covered by a SIEM contract

search.query: | where status="active" | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ domain=$domain|s$ declared_tier=$tier|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | eval c=if(siem_status="SIEM complete",1,0) | stats sum(c) as ok, count as total | eval pct=if(total=0,0,round(ok/total*100,1)) | fields pct
| search uhgid=$tenant|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | where siem_status="SIEM complete" | eval _time=siem_completed_epoch | timechart span=1mon count as "Contracts completed"

| search uhgid=$tenant|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | where siem_status="SIEM complete" | lookup dc_datasets_lookup uhgid OUTPUT ae_name as tenant | eval tenant=coalesce(mvindex(tenant,0),ae_name,uhgid) | stats count as "Contracts completed" by tenant | sort - "Contracts completed"

panel.title: Catalog - $cat_count$ datasets match the filters (10 per page)

search.query: | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ domain=$domain|s$ declared_tier=$tier|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* health=$health|s$ siem_status=$siem|s$ | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), contract=case(contract_scope="this tenant","own", contract_scope="another tenant or Core","shared - ".contract_held_by, 1=1,""), gate1_normalization=gate1_normalization.if(gate1_source="measured"," (measured)",""), gate2_detection=gate2_detection.if(gate2_source="measured"," (measured)","") | table dataset_id ae_name domain index sourcetype declared_tier proposed_tier health events_24h last_seen technical_owner siem_status contract contract_ticket contract_date schema_version gate1_normalization gate2_detection gate3_soc enterprise_ready | sort declared_tier ae_name sourcetype

panel.title: Shadow datasets (observed, not cataloged) by reason - see DC-38

search.query: | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | eval reason=case(classification IN ("CONTRACT_MATCHED_EXACT","CONTRACT_MATCHED_OTHER_TENANT"),"Contracted - waiting for next auto-catalog run", classification="UNMATCHED_NOVEL","No contract anywhere", classification="MALFORMED_SOURCETYPE","Malformed sourcetype", classification="REJECTED","Rejected sourcetype", 1=1,classification) | stats count by reason

panel.title: Ingested with no contract anywhere - needs a new SIEM contract (click a row to reject it instead)

search.query: | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | where classification="UNMATCHED_NOVEL" | stats sum(events_24h) as events_24h by uhgid, sourcetype, index | sort - events_24h

panel.title: Cataloged automatically from a SIEM contract - last 30 days (DC-00f, every 2 hours)

search.query: | where match(notes,"^Auto-cataloged") | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ domain=$domain|s$ sourcetype=*$st$* | rex field=notes "^Auto-cataloged (?<cataloged_on>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})" | where strptime(cataloged_on,"%Y-%m-%d")>=relative_time(now(),"-30d@d") | eval contract=case(contract_scope="this tenant","this tenant", contract_scope="another tenant or Core","shared - ".contract_held_by, 1=1,"contract no longer in master") | table cataloged_on dataset_id ae_name sourcetype index contract contract_ticket siem_status events_24h | sort - cataloged_on ae_name

panel.title: Malformed or rejected sourcetypes by tenant - needs source-side cleanup

search.query: | search uhgid=$tenant|s$ | where classification IN ("MALFORMED_SOURCETYPE","REJECTED") | stats sum(events_24h) as events_24h, dc(sourcetype) as distinct_bad_sourcetypes, values(classification) as classification by uhgid | sort - events_24h
